description: This file defines the HeadersInterface interface in the Slim Framework, which specifies methods for managing HTTP headers within PSR-7 HTTP message implementations.

classes.name: HeadersInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for manipulating HTTP headers (add, remove, get, set, check presence, retrieve all headers).

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Add a header value; appends the value to existing values for the header.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieve the value(s) of a header; returns a single value if only one exists, otherwise an array.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Replace the value of a header with a new value.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Replace all existing headers with a new set.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Check if a header exists in the collection.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieve all headers, with an option to get original case.
